def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    seed_time = pd.to_datetime(seed_time)
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # --- Заказы, существующие на момент seed_time (покупка уже совершена) ---
    orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]
    order_cols = ['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
                  'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']
    orders_f = orders[order_cols]

    # --- Позиции заказов: используем ts (момент покупки) для фильтрации ---
    items = order_items[order_items['ts'] <= seed_time]
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]

    merged = items.merge(orders_f, on='order_id', how='inner')
    # страховка от рассинхронизации ts и purchase_timestamp
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]

    merged['days_since_purchase'] = (seed_time - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days.astype(float)

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    # --- Признаки по продажам (вся история до seed_time) ---
    features['num_orders'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    features['num_items'] = merged.groupby('product_id').size()
    features['total_price'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
    features['total_freight'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['freight_value'].sum()
    features['avg_price'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['price'].mean()
    features['max_price'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['price'].max()
    features['avg_freight'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['freight_value'].mean()

    features['num_customers'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['customer_id'].nunique()
    features['num_sellers'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['seller_id'].nunique()

    # --- Давность покупок ---
    features['days_since_last_order'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['days_since_purchase'].min()
    features['days_since_first_order'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['days_since_purchase'].max()
    features['avg_days_since'] = merged.groupby('product_id')['days_since_purchase'].mean()

    # --- Скользящие окна ---
    for window in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        recent = merged[merged['days_since_purchase'] <= window]
        features[f'num_orders_{window}d'] = recent.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
        features[f'total_price_{window}d'] = recent.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
        features[f'num_items_{window}d'] = recent.groupby('product_id').size()

    # Тренд: продажи последних 30 дней vs предыдущих 30
    r30 = merged[merged['days_since_purchase'] <= 30].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    r60 = merged[(merged['days_since_purchase'] > 30) & (merged['days_since_purchase'] <= 60)] \
        .groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    features['trend_30_30'] = r30 - r60

    # --- Время доставки: только для заказов, доставленных ДО seed_time ---
    delivered_mask = merged['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                     (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    delivered = merged[delivered_mask].copy()
    delivered['delivery_time'] = (delivered['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
                                  delivered['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days.astype(float)
    features['avg_delivery_days'] = delivered.groupby('product_id')['delivery_time'].mean()
    features['num_delivered'] = delivered.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()

    # Опоздание доставки относительно оценки
    delivered['delay'] = (delivered['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
                          delivered['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days.astype(float)
    features['avg_delivery_delay'] = delivered.groupby('product_id')['delay'].mean()

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к seed_time ---
    prod_orders = merged[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
    rev = reviews[['order_id', 'review_score', 'review_creation_date']].copy()
    rev = rev[rev['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]
    rev = rev.drop_duplicates(subset=['order_id'])
    merged_rev = prod_orders.merge(rev, on='order_id', how='inner')
    features['avg_review_score'] = merged_rev.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].mean()
    features['num_reviews'] = merged_rev.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].count()
    features['bad_review_ratio'] = merged_rev.assign(
        bad=(merged_rev['review_score'] <= 2).astype(float)
    ).groupby('product_id')['bad'].mean()

    # --- Платежи: только те, что известны к seed_time ---
    pay = payments[['order_id', 'payment_type', 'payment_installments', 'payment_value', 'ts']].copy()
    pay = pay[pay['ts'] <= seed_time]
    merged_pay = prod_orders.merge(pay, on='order_id', how='inner')
    features['avg_payment_value'] = merged_pay.groupby('product_id')['payment_value'].mean()
    features['avg_payment_installments'] = merged_pay.groupby('product_id')['payment_installments'].mean()
    features['total_payment_sum'] = merged_pay.groupby('product_id')['payment_value'].sum()
    features['payment_transactions_count'] = merged_pay.groupby('product_id')['payment_value'].count()
    features['credit_card_ratio'] = merged_pay.assign(
        is_credit=(merged_pay['payment_type'] == 'credit_card').astype(float)
    ).groupby('product_id')['is_credit'].mean()

    # --- Индикатор наличия продаж ---
    features['has_sales'] = (features['num_orders'].fillna(0) > 0).astype(float)

    features = features.fillna(0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    return features
